content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, indicating partial success in file generation, the XML output failed to correctly map and embed the '위험등급' (Risk Level) value from the overview JSON into the HWPX document structure.
